title: Promote draft Callaway Chart Editor grid values to shipped code defaults

requirements.summary: Update shipped code-based default 9- and 18-hole Callaway grid charts to exactly match the edited draft Callaway Chart Editor values so fresh loads and resets use the new defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartPersistence.ts` functions `getDefault18GridChart()` and `getDefault9GridChart()` are updated so their `grid` and `columnAdjustments` values exactly match the edited values from the draft Callaway Chart Editor.
With a fresh browser profile (no existing localStorage keys for Callaway charts), the app loads using the updated default grid chart values for both 9-hole and 18-hole.

After clearing localStorage keys `callaway-grid-chart-18-user-default` and `callaway-grid-chart-9-user-default` (and any active grid keys), using “Reset to Defaults” results in the updated code-based defaults being used/initialized.

file_operations.description: Replace the hard-coded return values in `getDefault18GridChart()` and `getDefault9GridChart()` so the `grid` cell values and `columnAdjustments` exactly match the draft Callaway Chart Editor’s edited charts (copy the finalized draft values verbatim into these functions). Ensure no new localStorage keys or persistence mechanisms are introduced, and keep existing resolution order (active/edited → user-default → hard-coded default) intact.

requirements.summary: Update default-values documentation to reflect the new shipped defaults and explain how existing localStorage can hide code-default changes.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md` references the updated defaults and clearly states that existing localStorage user-default charts must be cleared to see code-default changes take effect.
All user-facing documentation text is in English.

file_operations.description: Revise the documentation to state that the shipped (code-based) defaults now match the draft Callaway Chart Editor’s edited chart values, and add/strengthen guidance that existing localStorage values (including user-default keys like `callaway-grid-chart-18-user-default` and `callaway-grid-chart-9-user-default`, plus any active grid keys) can mask code-default updates until cleared. Ensure all user-facing text remains in English.
